title: `src/textual/markup.py` has no `_parse`
note: `textual/markup.py` defines no `_parse` (it has `parse_style`, `to_content` and `_to_content`, and nothing that adds names). The import is in the file's `if __name__ == "__main__":` block, so `python -m textual.css.tokenize` raises ImportError: left behind by a refactor, and nothing in normal use runs it.

title: `src/flask/__init__.py` has no `Module`
note: `flask.Module` went when blueprints replaced modules; this test app still imports it. Importing the file would raise ImportError, but no test does: tests/test_helpers.py only serves the folder's static file.

title: `tests/benchmarks/corpus/google-genai/google/genai/_gaos/utils/serializers.py` has no `ALLOW_UNKNOWN_UNION_VARIANTS`
note: The frozen google-genai corpus (added in #14137) keeps unions.py, but its serializers.py was cut down to three functions and defines neither name, so `parse_open_union` raises ImportError when it reaches this line. The import is inside the function, so loading the corpus still works.
